ML-Intern is a curated repository documenting my machine learning learning journey through hands-on projects, experiments, and practical implementations.

A real-time gesture-to-text translation system designed to bridge communication gaps for the hearing impaired.
detailedDescription: Developed a real-time gesture recognition system that translates Indian sign language into Real Time Hindi speech to aid communication. By utilizing LSTM models to analyze the temporal sequences of hand landmarks captured via MediaPipe, the system achieves accurate detection of complex dynamic gestures.

objective: An automated cloud-to-cloud backup utility that fetches files from Telegram channels and archives them directly to specific Google Drive folders.
detailedDescription: Developed a specialized automation tool to solve local storage constraints and provide data redundancy against Telegram channel deletions. The bot allows users to fetch files and folders from any public or private Telegram channel by specifying a custom date range. By integrating with the Google Drive API, it facilitates direct cloud-to-cloud transfers to a designated folder via its Drive ID, ensuring critical data is preserved in a secure, organized environment without consuming local system resources.

objective: A security auditing tool for logging and analyzing IP addresses to monitor network protocols
detailedDescription: Developed a robust network utility tool for Linux environments focused on security auditing. The application is capable of logging and analyzing IP addresses to identify potential vulnerabilities, demonstrating a deep understanding of network protocols and server-side logging mechanisms.

objective: A high-accuracy vehicle license plate detection and automated data logging system optimized for Indian formats.
detailedDescription: Developed a high-accuracy detection system utilizing the YOLOv8 architecture specifically trained for Indian vehicle license plates. The system achieved 100% functional accuracy in testing environments across diverse Indian number plate formats. I also implemented an automated data logging feature that extracts recognized alphanumeric characters and saves them to a structured CSV file for efficient record-keeping.
